Several other outcomes were specified in the protocol or statistical analysis plan; all protocol-defined outcomes are summarised in the appendix (pp 22–79).

5.1.reasoning: The paper names a registration, protocol and statistical analysis plan but gives no date for any of them and says nothing about what the plan fixes for the measure or analysis of deaths up to day 28, so there is nothing to compare against the reported estimate (HR 0·80).

citations.text: Up to day 28, 18 deaths (6%) occurred in the hIVIG group and 22 deaths (8%) occurred in the placebo group (HR 0·80, 95% CI 0·42–1·51; p=0·49; table 2).

5.2.reasoning: The outcome is all-cause death counted to the trial's single 28-day follow-up, which can be measured in only one way, so there was no choice of measurement to make.

citations.text: The composite safety outcome at day 28 was summarised with hazard ratios (HRs) estimated from a proportional hazards model adjusted for baseline ordinal outcome category and hIVIG product provided to the site.
Up to day 28, 18 deaths (6%) occurred in the hIVIG group and 22 deaths (8%) occurred in the placebo group (HR 0·80, 95% CI 0·42–1·51; p=0·49; table 2).

5.3.reasoning: Deaths could have been analysed in more than one way (hazard ratio from a proportional hazards model vs simple proportions or odds ratios, adjusted or unadjusted), and the paper cites no dated plan that fixes the model, covariates or handling of follow-up for this outcome.
